---
title: "check-restated-results.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only heuristic check for the lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-29)
that a result first derived in an exercise solution is restated
in its own theorem-type div (`#thm-`, `#lem-`, `#cor-` or `#prp-`) after the exercise.

A `#sol-` div is a *derivation* when

- its exercise asks to derive, prove, show, solve, simplify or express something,
  or to find an expression, formula or closed form,
  and does not cite an existing result (`@thm-...`),
  which would make the solution a proof of a stated result; and
- the solution displays an equation.

The check follows `{{< include >}}` lines,
so it reads a page in the order a reader sees it.
After a derivation solution, a theorem-type div has to appear
before the next exercise of a different group
(the exercise slug with a trailing `-partK` removed).
A solution that holds `<!-- restated-ok: reason -->` is exempt.

A solution is checked when the pull request adds a line inside it or its exercise.
With no base to diff against, the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree,
so existing solutions are fixed when someone edits them anyway.
It warns by default; `fail: true` blocks.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Check every derivation solution, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-restated-results.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-restated-results.yml`.
